prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is visible, approach it and inspect. Otherwise, if object is approachable, grab it, do task, take it. Finally, scan area for object.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = InspectObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = DoTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGrabbed    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			SEQUENCE
				DO ApproachObject
					IF IsObjectGrabbed? THEN
					DO InspectObjectProperties
			END
	END
